title_zh: 调整篮球运球后将球留在界内

scenario.label_zh: 调整篮球练习避免球出界
scenario.goal_zh: 按教练提示降低运球高度，并在重试后确认球未越过边线

context_zh: 篮球入门练习中，学员针对球总弹出边线的问题重试。
author: author-phase10-a

sentences.speaker: Noah
sentences.text: The ball keeps going over the boundary when I turn. Am I pushing it too far ahead?

sentences.speaker: Coach Aziz
sentences.text: Yes. Try to bounce it closer to your side and a little lower.

sentences.speaker: Noah
sentences.text: Like this? I've slowed down and kept the bounce lower so the ball stays next to me.

sentences.speaker: Coach Aziz
sentences.text: Better. Turn at the cone again and watch where it lands.

sentences.speaker: Noah
sentences.text: That time it stayed inside the line.

sentences.speaker: Coach Aziz
sentences.text: It did. Use that slower pace for the next few turns.
